messages:
acme-dev: Hey, our account shows $200 trial credits in the Console but API usage is still billing us / showing credits_balance: 0 in the usage API. Charged invoices showed up. Can someone look? account_id: acct_ABC123

maya (Support): Sorry about that — can you paste the account id + first 8 of billing_customer_id? also approximate timestamps of the charges?

acme-dev: account_id acct_ABC123 billing_customer_id bc_98765432 charges around 2026-03-15 02:30 UTC. Quick curl we ran:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/account/acct_ABC123
# response: {"credits_balance":0,"promos":[]}
```

maya (Support): Thanks. escalating to billing. /cc @aj

deploy-bot: Ticket created: IN-1129 - Billing mismatch (acct_ABC123) — assigned to aj

aj (Billing): I'm on it. Can you confirm if the promo code was applied via Console or via internal grant? did you use promo code 'REDWOOD_TRIAL_2026'?

acme-dev: We signed up via self-serve, didn't paste any promo code. Console shows 'Trial credit granted — 2026-03-14' in the account activity.

liam (SRE): I'll check the provisioning logs for the grant propagation to billing pipeline. Maya — can you DM me the account_id API key? don't paste in channel.

maya (Support): Sent via DM.

liam (SRE): Found an error in the grant sync: grant record exists in console_tenant db but missing external_billing_customer_id field, so downstream billing service ignored it. Root cause: id mapping failed during signup cluster migration.

aj (Billing): We can reattach the grant to billing_customer_id bc_98765432 and re-run credit apply job. We'll also refund any charged usage within the trial quota timespan.

maya (Support): Plan: (1) Reattach grant now (2) run apply_credits job (3) refund invoices or credit account (4) confirm with customer. ETA ~30-45m. @acme-dev will that work?

acme-dev: Yes that'd be great, thanks.

deploy-bot: Job apply_credits for acct_ABC123 started (job_id job_20260315_001) — logs: 'attached grant id g_445 -> bc_98765432'

aj (Billing): Apply job completed. API now returns {\"credits_balance\":200.00,\"promos\":[\"trial-2026\"]} for acct_ABC123. I've credited any invoices covering usage up to trial limit. Please verify.

acme-dev: Checked — API now shows credits and invoices show refund line items, balance correct. Thanks!

maya (Support): :tada: Closing the thread once you confirm there's no other issue.

liam (SRE): Created postmortem draft — root cause: signup migration mapping bug. We'll add a step in onboarding to verify billing mapping. CC @aj.

aj (Billing): Marked resolved in IN-1129 and scheduled follow-up task BILL-457 for migration fix.

acme-dev: All good on our side. Appreciate the fast help :heart:
